title: Finding room SJT 301
question: Where is SJT 301?
content: SJT 301 is on the third floor of the Silver Jubilee Tower (SJT). Use the main lift or staircase and follow the third-floor room signs.

title: Finding room TT 204
question: Where is TT 204?
content: TT 204 is on the second floor of the Technology Tower (TT). Enter through the main lobby and follow the second-floor classroom signs.

title: Finding room MB 101
question: Where is MB 101?
content: MB 101 is on the first floor of the Main Building (MB), beside the first-floor staircase.

title: Finding your classroom
question: How do I find my assigned classroom?
content: Check the room code in your student timetable. The letters identify the building and the first digit identifies the floor. If the timetable has no room code, contact the academic office.

title: Robotics lab hours
question: When is the robotics lab open?
content: The Robotics Lab in TT 115 is open Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM. Supervised project access is available Saturday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM, with prior faculty approval.

title: Computer lab hours
question: When does the computer lab open?
content: The Computer Lab in SJT 201 is open Monday–Saturday, 8:00 AM–8:00 PM. It is closed on Sundays and campus holidays.

title: Chemistry lab hours
question: When is the chemistry lab open?
content: The Chemistry Lab in MB 110 runs scheduled practical sessions Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–4:00 PM. Walk-in access is not available.

title: Booking a lab workstation
question: How do I book a lab workstation?
content: Submit a workstation request through the student portal under Academics → Lab booking at least one working day in advance. Include the lab name, preferred time, and faculty supervisor.

title: Lab safety requirements
question: What should I bring to the chemistry lab?
content: Bring your student ID, lab coat, closed-toe shoes, and the practical record. Safety goggles are provided by the Chemistry Lab. Follow the supervising instructor’s safety briefing.

title: Campus Hackathon registration
question: How do I register for the Campus Hackathon?
content: Register for the Campus Hackathon through Student portal → Events → Campus Hackathon 2026. Registration closes on 20 October 2026 at 6:00 PM IST. Teams may have 2–4 students. The event takes place on 23 October 2026 in Anna Auditorium.

title: Research Expo registration
question: How do I register for the Research Expo?
content: Register for Research Expo 2026 through Student portal → Events → Research Expo by 22 October 2026 at 5:00 PM IST. Individual and team submissions are accepted. The expo takes place on 28 October 2026 in the Convention Centre.

title: Editing an event registration
question: Can I change my event team?
content: Before the event registration deadline, open your registration in Student portal → Events → My registrations and choose Edit team. After the deadline, contact the event coordinator listed on the event page.

title: Event registration confirmation
question: Where can I find my event registration confirmation?
content: Open Student portal → Events → My registrations. A confirmed registration shows a registration ID and event details. If a completed registration is missing, send the event name and payment reference, if any, to student support.

title: Replacing a lost student ID
question: How do I replace a lost student ID?
content: Report the lost ID through Student portal → Student services → ID replacement. Upload a recent photograph and pay the demo replacement fee of ₹200. Collect the replacement from the Student Support Office after three working days with your application receipt.

title: Requesting a bonafide certificate
question: How do I request a bonafide certificate?
content: Apply through Student portal → Student services → Certificates → Bonafide. Select the purpose and submit the request. Approved certificates are normally available within two working days.

title: Applying for leave
question: How do I apply for leave?
content: Submit a leave request in Student portal → Attendance → Leave request. Enter the dates, reason, and supporting document if applicable. Leave is valid only after faculty advisor approval.

title: Correcting attendance
question: How can I correct my attendance?
content: Report an attendance discrepancy to the course faculty within three working days. Include the course code, session date, and supporting evidence. The course faculty reviews and submits any correction.

title: Reporting a maintenance issue
question: How do I report a broken classroom projector?
content: Open Student portal → Support → Facilities and create a maintenance request. Include the building, room number, issue description, and an optional photograph. Keep the request ID for follow-up.

title: Student support office hours
question: When is the student support office open?
content: The Student Support Office is in MB 012 on the ground floor of the Main Building. It is open Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM, with a lunch break from 1:00 PM–2:00 PM.

title: Library opening hours
question: What time does the library close?
content: The Central Library is open Monday–Saturday, 8:00 AM–10:00 PM, and Sunday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM. Holiday hours are announced separately.

title: Borrowing library books
question: How many library books can I borrow?
content: Students may borrow up to four general-collection books for 14 days using a valid student ID. Reference books must remain in the library.

title: Renewing a library book
question: How do I renew a library book?
content: Use Library portal → My loans → Renew before the due date. One renewal of 14 days is allowed if no other student has reserved the book.

title: Connecting to campus Wi-Fi
question: How do I connect to campus Wi-Fi?
content: Select VIT-Student in your Wi-Fi settings and sign in with your student portal username and password. If sign-in fails, forget the network and reconnect. Never share your password with support staff.

title: Resetting a portal password
question: How do I reset my student portal password?
content: Choose Forgot password on the student portal sign-in page. Enter your registration number and use the verification link sent to your registered email. If you cannot access that email, contact the IT Helpdesk with your student ID.

title: IT Helpdesk location and hours
question: Where is the IT Helpdesk?
content: The IT Helpdesk is in SJT 005 on the ground floor of Silver Jubilee Tower. Walk-in support is available Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM.

title: Campus building directory
content:
## Silver Jubilee Tower (SJT)
SJT houses computing classrooms and the Computer Lab. SJT 301 is on the third floor, SJT 201 on the second floor, and the IT Helpdesk in SJT 005 on the ground floor.

## Technology Tower (TT)
TT houses engineering classrooms. TT 204 is on the second floor. The Robotics Lab is in TT 115 on the first floor.

## Main Building (MB)
MB 101 is on the first floor. The Chemistry Lab is in MB 110 on the first floor. The Student Support Office is in MB 012 on the ground floor.

title: Laboratory access guide
content:
## Booking and supervision
Request a workstation through Student portal → Academics → Lab booking at least one working day before the session. Include the lab name, preferred time, and faculty supervisor. A booking does not override scheduled teaching sessions.

## Robotics Lab
The Robotics Lab in TT 115 is open Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM. Saturday project access is 9:00 AM–1:00 PM and requires prior faculty approval.

## Computer and Chemistry Labs
The Computer Lab in SJT 201 is open Monday–Saturday, 8:00 AM–8:00 PM. The Chemistry Lab in MB 110 offers scheduled practicals Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–4:00 PM; no walk-in access. Bring your ID, lab coat, closed-toe shoes, and practical record for chemistry sessions.

title: October 2026 event guide
content:
## Campus Hackathon 2026
Register through Student portal → Events → Campus Hackathon 2026 by 20 October 2026, 6:00 PM IST. Teams have 2–4 students. The event is on 23 October 2026 in Anna Auditorium.

## Research Expo 2026
Register through Student portal → Events → Research Expo by 22 October 2026, 5:00 PM IST. Individual and team submissions are accepted. The event is on 28 October 2026 in the Convention Centre.

## Confirmation and changes
Find registration IDs in Events → My registrations. Edit team details before the registration deadline. After the deadline, contact the event coordinator listed on the event page.

title: Student services handbook
content:
## Student Support Office
Visit MB 012, Main Building ground floor, Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM. The lunch break is 1:00 PM–2:00 PM.

## ID replacement
Report a lost ID through Student services → ID replacement. Upload a recent photo and pay the demo fee of ₹200. Bring the application receipt to collect the replacement after three working days.

## Certificates and attendance
Bonafide applications are under Student services → Certificates → Bonafide; normal processing is two working days. Report attendance discrepancies to course faculty within three working days with the course code, session date, and evidence.
